6e36cecefba2.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev2 Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Key:secret Action:block To: CreatedAt:}]}
6e36cecefba2.sql:
SELECT substr(col, 6) AS a, attr_value, count(*) AS c FROM (
		UNPIVOT (SELECT COLUMNS('^attr_') FROM product WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10') ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME col VALUE attr_value)
		GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY c DESC, a, attr_value LIMIT 5

c885ac77e47f.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev2 Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Key:secret Action:block To: CreatedAt:}]}
c885ac77e47f.sql:
SELECT event_name, substr(col, 6) AS a, attr_value, count(*) AS c FROM (
		UNPIVOT (SELECT event_name, COLUMNS('^attr_') FROM product WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10') ON COLUMNS('^attr_') INTO NAME col VALUE attr_value)
		GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY event_name, a, c DESC, attr_value
